project.name: Porch Light
project.summary: A care-facility outreach workbench: you open any of the 3,235 Census counties on the hosted desk and get a deterministically ranked call sheet from a published Zetaris audit, with sourced contacts, score terms, refusals, and a Nemotron draft where that snapshot has one. Every catalog county has been source-audited at least once; the hosted pack shows 2,490 counties with ranked rows (2,491 after a Robertson retry that is not in the pack), 14,960 passed and 480 failed drafts, and clinical validation, offline GPU inference, and automatic outreach are not claimed.

builders.name: Joe Gaither
builders.role: owner: decides, reviews and merges; agents write the code

zetaris.how: Audited Zetaris SQL joins CMS, Census, SVI, and emPOWER, with SQL-measured match counts and query ids a judge can read on the hosted county sheet. The source relations share one read-only PostGIS datasource. The live desk serves the published audit (sweep 20261023T200048Z-78a426ba). A Unified Semantic Layer across multiple live physical systems is not claimed.
data_sources: porchlight_postgis: read-only PostgreSQL/PostGIS source containing captured public records and pre-joined exports

meterless.how: Runtime model calls use the local Nightshift gateway, route meterless/deep, thinking disabled. Scout Intent (engines/scout_intent.py) gates the live call-script path: the executor checks an HMAC-SHA256 contract before any provider call. Batch explanation drafts are not contract-gated. H-MEM, World Model, Markovian, and local model execution are not claimed. engines/openrouter_backup.py is optional and stays off unless OPENROUTER_API_KEY and PORCHLIGHT_OPENROUTER_BACKUP are set. No OpenRouter spend is claimed, and OpenRouter is not a scoring sponsor.

cursor.how: Cursor cloud agents wrote Storm Watch v2 and the Storm Glass Desk design (merged PR #22) and the national county and alert web wiring (merged PR #24). Cursor also supplies the .cursor/rules/ files. Devin wrote the contract (PR #14), the data, the engines, and most of the web. Joe directed the work. No token count or spend is recorded.

nvidia.how: Both free Nemotron ids are on meterless/deep with thinking disabled: nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b and nvidia/nemotron-3.5-super-vl-120b-a12b. The published county pack (generated 2026-10-24T16:47:04Z) holds 14,960 passed and 480 failed facility drafts; execution_location on those receipts is nvidia_cloud, and paid_fallback_enabled is false. Nemotron does not rank. The retained Scout Intent script is one facility, CCN 102853, receipt rcpt_req_qsa07grv, actual_usd 0. Local GPU, offline DGX, Parse, and Content Safety are not claimed.

run.setup: Open https://porchlight.earth. Hosted county sheets need no credentials (sample path: /nationwide?county=02020, 35013, 48201). New Zetaris jobs, alert runs, and model POST stay on localhost. See README.md Setup. The Milton sheet is /operate.

evidence_logs: Hosted county evidence is web/data/national/published/ (Zetaris query ids and model_executions). engines/reports/scout-intent-live-2026-10-23.json retains one live call-script receipt. Scout Intent decisions on a local machine append to ~/.porchlight/scout-intent/events.jsonl.
